basic_info.description: Nestled in prestigious Nob Hill, this elegant condo has approximately 1155 sq ft. Featuring an ideal 100 Walk Score, moments from Union Square, Chinatown, BART, top-tier shopping, luxury hotels, and San Francisco's finest dining and entertainment. The iconic cable car at your door offers seamless commutes to the Financial District, East Bay, South Bay, and SFO. Inside, matchstick hardwood floors, architectural arches, and a decorative fireplace exude timeless charm. French doors in the primary bedroom and livable space open to Powell Street views, bathing the open-concept layout in light, flowing into a formal dining room. The chef's kitchen shines with new LG stainless steel appliances, gas range, Pacific high CFM hood, modern cabinets, and marble counters. Two bedrooms with walk-in closets, a bathroom with glass-door tub and pedestal sink, and radiant heating elevate comfort. Enjoy in-unit laundry, a common garden, elevator, and large private storage in this well-managed building. Leased parking is nearby. Blending serene retreat with vibrant urban living, this gem epitomizes San Francisco don't miss out.
